title: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
summary: An explosive two-hand pass from the chest against a wall, for upper-body power.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: medicine ball or slam ball.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.45 for chest (helper): each working set adds 0.45 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.35 for triceps (minor): each working set adds 0.35 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.3 for front delts (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Hold the ball at your chest facing a wall.
Throw it hard into the wall from your chest.

form_cues.cue: Throw it fast. The throw is the point.

mistakes.text: Throwing with the arms only and no leg drive.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Similar muscles; bodyweight instead of medicine ball.
Swap sheet: More stable, Heavier loading potential, Easier to learn.
Swap sheet: More systemic fatigue, Heavier loading potential.
Swap sheet: One side at a time, More systemic fatigue, Heavier loading potential.
